mapper.insert: insert into tb_warehouse_stock (warehouse_no, goods_no, stock_qty) values (#{warehouseNo}, #{goodsNo}, #{qty})

select seq_history.nextval from dual
insert into tb_stock_history ( history_no, group_no, history_type, warehouse_no, goods_no, qty, before_qty, after_qty, member_id, request_no, memo, history_date ) values ( #{historyNo}, #{groupNo}, #{historyType}, #{warehouseNo}, #{goodsNo}, #{qty}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{memberId}, #{requestNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate )
mapper.select: select h.history_no, h.group_no, h.history_type, h.warehouse_no, h.goods_no, h.qty, h.before_qty, h.after_qty, h.member_id, h.request_no, h.memo, h.history_date, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, w.warehouse_name from tb_stock_history h join tb_goods g on h.goods_no = g.goods_no join tb_warehouse w on h.warehouse_no = w.warehouse_no order by h.history_no desc, h.history_type desc

select h.history_no, h.group_no, h.history_type, h.warehouse_no, h.goods_no, h.qty, h.before_qty, h.after_qty, h.member_id, h.request_no, h.memo, h.history_date, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, w.warehouse_name from tb_stock_history h join tb_goods g on h.goods_no = g.goods_no join tb_warehouse w on h.warehouse_no = w.warehouse_no
and h.history_date >= to_date(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
and h.history_date < to_date(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
and h.warehouse_no = #{warehouseNo}
and (upper(g.goods_code) like '%' || upper(#{keyword}) || '%' or upper(g.goods_name) like '%' || upper(#{keyword}) || '%')
order by h.history_no desc, h.history_type desc
